outage_plan.t:
• Utility bulletin: {core} enters a scheduled refuelling shutdown on {start}; expected length {dur}.
• Please align maintenance and staffing plans.
Auto-forward from the grid operator: reactor {core} will go down for a planned fuel swap at {start}, for {dur}. — ops bot; human here says calendar it.
Power company tell us: reactor {core} planned refuelling stop begin {start}, stay stop for {dur}. Please note.

For the record, the utility has formally scheduled reactor {core} for a planned refuelling outage starting {start}; the anticipated outage length is {dur}, and this remains a planned evolution rather than a forced trip.
utility says {core} gets planned refuel break starting {start}, lasts {dur}. log it.
Word from the power company: {core} is to be taken down for refuelling on {start}, and they reckon it'll stay out for {dur}. Thought you'd want to know.
Notice: The power utility has announced that reactor {core} will begin a planned refuelling shutdown at {start}, with a duration of {dur}.
Coffee-room heads-up: the utility says {core} is going into a scheduled refuelling outage at {start}; they're quoting {dur}. Don't panic, it's planned.
The grid operator advises that reactor {core} will commence a planned refuelling outage at {start} and remain offline for {dur}.
FW from the power company: planned refuel outage — unit {core}, start {start}, duration {dur}. Human note: put it on the board.
Hello. Power company informs planned refuelling outage for {core} start {start}, last {dur}. Thank you.

Per the utility's schedule, {core} is set for a planned refuelling outage beginning {start}; the stated outage duration is {dur}. Please distinguish this from the earlier HV, flasher, and water-leak concerns; it is an announced refuelling shutdown.
{core} refuelling outage, planned, starts {start}, {dur} on the board. utility says so.
Just heard from the grid folk: {core} is being taken down for a planned refuelling stop at {start}, for {dur}. Mark your diaries, friends.
老伙计们，供电那头捎来口信：{core}计划自{start}起换料大修，前后得{dur}，大家心里有个数。
刚看到电力公司的公告，说{core}要从{start}开始计划停堆换料，持续{dur}，太好了，这段时间正好调探测器的本底！
夜班留个记录：电网来函，{core}计划于{start}停堆换料，工期{dur}。咖啡见底了，先顶着。
电网说 {core} 计划换料停堆，{start} 起，{dur}。完。
值班通告：电力公司已发布计划，{core}反应堆将于{start}起进行换料大修，预计持续{dur}。特此记录。
でんりょくよりれんらく。{core} は {start} から {dur} のねんりょうこうかんていしにはいる。よてい。
電力自動通知: {core} の計画燃料交換停止、開始 {start}、期間 {dur}。担当メモ: 了解、予定表に反映。
現場より。電力から連絡、{core} は {start} から {dur} の燃料交換停止に入る予定だって。了解。
ご連絡申し上げます。電力会社の発表によれば、{core} につきまして、{start} より {dur} の燃料交換のための計画停止がございます。

He revisado el calendario de mantenimiento y, para que quede constancia, la compañía eléctrica anuncia oficialmente una parada programada de recarga de combustible en el reactor {core}; el inicio queda fijado para {start} y la parada se extenderá durante {dur}.
Noche tranquila por ahora; la empresa avisa que el reactor {core} se va a parada programada de recarga desde {start} y estará así {dur}.
La compañía de energía anuncia: reactor {core} tiene parada planeada para recargar combustible. Empieza {start}. Dura {dur}.
• Anuncio de la compañía eléctrica: parada programada de recarga para el reactor {core}. • Inicio: {start}. • Duración: {dur}.

outage_correction.t: ref {ref}: {core} outage now kicks off {start}, runs {dur}. scrap earlier.
AUTO FWD: {ref} updated. {core} outage start corrected to {start}; expected span {dur}. (bot note: ignore prior schedule.)
Corrigendum to bulletin {ref}. The scheduled outage of reactor {core} is hereby revised: commencement {start}, duration {dur}.
ugh, {ref} changed again. {core} now down from {start}, for {dur}. coffee not helping.
Pray amend notice {ref}: the {core} reactor's outage shall commence {start} and endure {dur}.
Sorry, correction notice {ref}. For {core}, new start {start}, and it continues {dur}.
Update to {ref}: {core} outage shifted to {start}; length now {dur}. Not a drill.
Please replace {ref}: {core} outage begins {start}, stays out {dur}. Thanks.
Per {ref}: {core} outage moves to {start}; window is {dur}. Night shift sends.
Correction: see {ref}. {core} outage start is {start}; total length {dur}. Apologies for confusion.
Revised outage notice {ref}: {core} begins {start}, lasts {dur}. This supersedes earlier.
Notice {ref} amendment: {core} outage now set for {start}, with duration {dur}.
Heads up, {ref} is wrong on timing. {core} outage starts {start} and runs {dur}. I'm on break.
Correction to {ref}: {core} outage new start {start}, new duration {dur}. End of message.

• 更正 {ref}：{core} 停堆改从 {start} 开始，持续 {dur}。
• 其他不变，散会后我再核对。
兹更正 {ref} 所载事项：{core} 反应堆停运现调整为 {start} 起始，延续 {dur}。特此通告。
刚看到更新！{ref} 那个通知要改：{core} 的停堆现在从 {start} 才开始，持续 {dur}！我先去盯数据啦～
现场说下：{ref} 要更新，{core} 停堆改到 {start} 起，撑 {dur}。信号不好先这样。
ref {ref} 修正：{core} 停堆从 {start} 开始，持续 {dur}。ok

【自动转发】原通知 {ref} 更新：{core} 停堆改至 {start} 开始，持续 {dur}。
（人注：这次是真的，别再来问。）
あー、{ref} の訂正だけど、{core} の停止、開始が {start} になって、そのあと {dur} 続く感じ。夜勤中にごめん。
{ref} を修正します。{core} の停止は {start} から。期間は {dur}。
先に流した {ref} について、誤りがあったため訂正いたします。対象は {core} の停止で、開始は {start} に、継続時間は {dur} に読み替えてください。
Distinguidos colegas, me permito enmendar el aviso {ref}: la parada del reactor {core} queda fijada para dar comienzo {start} y tendrá una extensión de {dur}.
¡Ojo! Rectificación del comunicado {ref}: el paro del reactor {core} ahora arranca {start} y se alarga {dur}.
Corrección para el aviso {ref}. El reactor {core} tiene nueva parada: empieza {start}, dura {dur}.

scram.t: Ugh, {core} scrammed on us at {at}. Automatic, unplanned. Restart expected in {restart}.
Automated notice: reactor {core} emergency shutdown at {at}; automatic protection initiated. Operator comment: restart expected in {restart}.
Whoa—{core} just scrammed automatically at {at}, totally unplanned! They say it should restart in {restart}. Background runs will be interesting.
{core} auto-tripped at {at}, unplanned. Crew expects restart in {restart}. Typing with gloves, sorry.
Notification: reactor {core} underwent an unplanned automatic shutdown at {at}. Restart is expected in {restart}.
Shift log: {core} tripped automatically at {at}—unplanned. Estimated back in {restart}.
Just got word: {core} had an automatic scram at {at}, not planned. They're projecting restart in {restart}.
{core} auto scram at {at}. Unplanned. Next restart in {restart}. Will update.
Attention: {core} experienced an automatic reactor trip at {at}. This was unplanned. Anticipated restart in {restart}.
Reactor {core} auto-tripped at {at}; unplanned. Restart expected in {restart}. Also the flasher runs are noisy again, unrelated.
yo {core} did an auto scram at {at}, wasn't planned. restart in {restart}, per plant.
Reactor {core}: unplanned automatic shutdown at {at}. Restart expected in {restart}.
Power company advises {core} tripped automatically at {at}; the shutdown was unplanned. They expect restart in {restart}.
自动告警转发：{core} 在 {at} 非计划自动停堆，预计 {restart} 重启。值班备注：收到，先别刷屏。
通报：{core} 于 {at} 发生非计划自动紧急停堆，现按程序处理，预计 {restart} 恢复运行。请各相关方保持关注。
记：{core} {at} 跳堆，非计划自动，预计 {restart} 重启。
给大伙儿提个醒，{core} 在 {at} 自己跳堆了，非计划自动的，说是 {restart} 就能重新开起来。
项目通报：- {core} 于 {at} 非计划自动停堆；- 原因按厂内流程跟进；- 预计 {restart} 重启。
现场消息：{core} 在 {at} 自己跳堆了，非计划自动停堆，我这边看预计 {restart} 重启。
あー、{core} が {at} にスクラム踏んだって。再立ち上げは {restart} らしい。
やばい！{core} が {at} に自動緊急停止！復帰は {restart} だって！
ご報告申し上げます。{core} は {at} に予期せぬ自動停止となりました。再始動は {restart} の由にございます。
・{core}：{at} に自動緊急停止 ・再起動見込み：{restart}

A la atención de la sala de control: el reactor {core} ha sufrido un disparo automático no previsto a las {at}; se aguarda que vuelva a marchar en {restart}. Un saludo cordial, ya saben que estoy de apoyo.
Reactor {core} hizo parada de emergencia automática no planificada a las {at}. Nos dicen que reinicio en {restart}. Gracias.
Se comunica que el reactor {core} ha experimentado una parada automática de emergencia no programada a las {at}. La reanudación de operación está prevista en {restart}. Fin del comunicado.
• Reactor {core}: parada automática no programada a las {at}. • Rearranque previsto en {restart}.

temp_event.t: Chiller hiccup down in the hall; central-detector LS temp moved by {dk}. Energy scale needs a fresh look.
The refrigerating apparatus misbehaved, and the liquid scintillator temperature has shifted by {dk}. In my day we would not trust the energy scale until it was checked again.
AUTO: HVAC fault cleared, residual LS temperature delta {dk}. Human note: energy-scale calibration likely stale.

Because the chilled-water loop lost regulation, the central detector's liquid-scintillator temperature changed by {dk}; because light yield and timing drift with temperature, the energy scale should be revalidated before we use the data.
Be advised: an anomaly in the detector cooling system produced a liquid-scintillator temperature variation of {dk}. This condition affects the energy-scale calibration; please assess and document.
Cooling messed up, LS temp moved by {dk}. Energy scale is probably off. Coffee not helping.
yo chiller went weird, ls temp changed by {dk}, energy scale gonna need a look
Pray note: the refrigerating apparatus failed; the liquid scintillator registereth a temperature change of {dk}. Reckon the energy scale wants attention.
Notice from slow control: a chiller fault is associated with a central-detector LS temperature change of {dk}. Comment: energy scale not to be trusted until recalculated.

The HVAC fault altered the thermal environment of the central detector, and consequently the liquid-scintillator temperature changed by {dk}; this matters because the energy scale is temperature-sensitive and must be corrected.
This bulletin reports a cooling-loop malfunction that led to a liquid-scintillator temperature shift of {dk}. The shift is relevant to the energy-scale determination.
HVAC acting up at the detector; LS temperature changed by {dk}. Need to redo energy-scale checks.
AUTOMATED: chiller anomaly, LS temp delta {dk}. Human: energy calibration affected.
Chiller gave us trouble; central detector LS temp is off by {dk}. Energy scale won't be happy.
冷却回路这边有点异常，空调/冷水机组没能把液闪温度稳住，结果中心探测器温度相对参考状态偏移了 {dk}；这个偏移会直接影响能量刻度，分析前务必按温度修正处理，别忽略。
通报：因冷却系统故障，中心探测器液闪温度发生 {dk} 变化。该变化对能量刻度有影响，请各岗位按规程关注后续校准。
HVAC 有问题，液闪温度变了 {dk}。这个对能量刻度很重要，请检查。
现场看，冷水机那边出毛病了，液闪温度飘了 {dk}，能量刻度会受影响，先记着。
夜班上报：冷却那边不太对，液闪温度动了 {dk}，能量刻度估计得改，我先眯会儿，你们接着看。
自动告警转发：冷却系统异常，中心探测器液闪温度变化 {dk}。人工备注：能量刻度会受此影响，请留意。
[自動通知] 中央検出器の冷却系異常でLS温度が{dk}変化。エネルギー較正に影響。担当者より一言: チラー警報、確認はコーヒー後で。
ちらーけいほう。ちゅうおうのえきしんおんど {dk} へんか。えねすけーるにひびく。ようちゅうい。
・冷却系トラブルで中央検出器の液シン温度が{dk}変動 ・エネルギー較正に影響あり ・至急、状況と対応方針を共有ください
あー、チラー止まってたみたいで、中央の液シン温度が{dk}変わっちゃった。これエネルギー再構成に効くやつだから、あとで見ときます。
El chiller del detector central se puso raro y la temperatura del LS cambió {dk}; esto nos va a mover la escala de energía, aviso por si hay que recalibrar. Qué noche...

Para que quede claro: una falla en el lazo de enfriamiento/HVAC del detector central provocó una variación de {dk} en la temperatura del centelleador líquido. Como el rendimiento de luz depende de la temperatura, la escala de energía queda afectada. Conviene revisar la calibración antes de usar estos datos.
• Problema de climatización/chiller en el detector central. • La temperatura del LS varió {dk}. • Impacto: la escala de energía puede desplazarse; priorizar verificación.

Se informa que una anomalía en el sistema de refrigeración del detector central produjo un cambio de {dk} en la temperatura del líquido centelleador, lo que incide en la determinación de la escala de energía.

temp_minor.t: Slow-control chit here: the hall thermometer drifted by {dk}, but our scintillator bath never budged; the energy calibration is just as it was.
yo ops, env temp in the electronics room moved {dk}. cd/ls side is stable, no shift in e-scale. all good
We see temperature change {dk} in water pool. Liquid scintillator is not changed. Energy scale no change.
[auto] env sensor update: delta T {dk} at water pool. Human note: CD/LS stable, calib fine.
Facilities bulletin: a temperature excursion of {dk} was recorded in the experimental hall. The central liquid-scintillator detector remained thermally stable, and the energy scale is unaffected.
Whoa, hall temp jumped by {dk}! But the LS is totally chill - no, I mean stable - and the energy scale didn't flinch.
Ops: electronics room ambient changed {dk}. Scintillator hasn't moved, e-cal same. Coffee still bad.
Automated notice: water-pool temp delta {dk}. Comment from shift: no CD/LS change, no energy-scale impact.
Temperature in hall changed by {dk}. Central detector liquid stable. Energy scale not affected.
Duty log, old style: the hall environs moved by {dk}, yet the liquid scintillator held steady and the energy scale stayed put.

Notice from operations: ambient temperature variation of {dk} occurred in the electronics room. Neither the central detector nor the liquid scintillator changed; energy-scale response remains nominal.
temp in wp moved {dk}, but ls/cd stable. no cal shift. carry on
Just saw the water-pool thermometer move {dk} - not the LS! Energy scale looks untouched, so no panic.
AUTO: pool temp delta {dk}. Shift note: CD stable, LS stable, energy scale unchanged.
慢控制系统记录：实验厅环境温度变化 {dk}，该变化局限于实验厅暖通回路，中央探测器液闪温度未受影响，保持稳定；能量刻度无需调整，物理数据质量不变。请知悉。
现场看过了，电子学间温度动了 {dk}，就那边的事；液闪和中心探测器稳得很，能量刻度没动。手机打字，见谅。
诸位同事：老朽在水池边巡视，察觉水温较前有 {dk} 之变，然此乃水池环境之变，中央液闪依旧安稳如常，能量标尺未受牵动，特此禀报。
哎我刚看慢控！水池那边温度跳了 {dk}！重点：只是水池，不是中心探测器液闪，液闪稳稳的，能标纹丝没动，数据放心用！
夜班中。实验厅温度变化 {dk}，困。只涉及厅内环境，液闪没动，能量刻度也没漂。继续盯。
【自动通知】慢控温度告警：电子学间温度变化 {dk}。值班备注：仅限电子学间环境，中央液闪温度稳定，能量刻度无影响。
現場からです。実験ホールの気温が{dk}動きました。液体シンチと中心検出器は安定のまま、エネルギースケールにも影響なしです。
夜勤中、電子機器室の温度が{dk}ずれた。中心検出器側は安定していて、エネルギー目盛りは変わってない。眠い。
水プールの温度が{dk}変わりました。液体シンチレーターはそのままです。エネルギーはだいじょうぶです。
記録として残します。実験ホール空調側の温度変化は{dk}でしたが、液体シンチレータおよび中心検出器の温度は安定を維持しており、エネルギー較正に系統的な影響は生じていません。
Aviso rapidito: un cambio térmico de {dk} en la sala experimental; el detector central ni se enteró y la escala de energía sigue igual.
Hay un cambio de temperatura de {dk} en la sala de electrónica. El líquido centelleador está estable. No hay efecto en la escala de energía.
¡Gente! Acabo de ver un cambio de temperatura de {dk} en la piscina de agua, pero el detector central no se movió nada; la escala de energía sigue igualita. ¡Todo bajo control!
Turno noche: se registró un cambio térmico de {dk} en la sala experimental; el líquido centelleador permanece estable y la escala de energía no presenta cambios. Voy por café.

quake_felt.t: Whoa, the seismo feed just flagged a magnitude {mag} event {dist} from here, and I felt the desk shake while I was grabbing coffee!
This is a formal notice from the national seismic duty desk: an earthquake of magnitude {mag} occurred {dist} away, and ground shaking was reported at the detector site.
Seismology says earthquake magnitude {mag}. Distance {dist} away. We feel shaking in detector hall.
quake m{mag}, {dist} out. felt it on site.
AUTOMATED ALERT: Seismic event, magnitude {mag}, distance {dist} from site. Human note: yes, we felt that shaking in the control room.

For the record, the seismic monitoring stream reports a magnitude {mag} earthquake whose epicenter is {dist} distant from our location; I want to confirm that the shaking was clearly felt here at the site, possibly through the floor slab.
Hey team, just got pinged by the seismology feed: magnitude {mag}, {dist} away, and the whole control room felt the tremor. Anyway, coffee is fresh.
Seismic event confirmed: magnitude {mag}, distance {dist} away. Site experienced felt shaking. Immediate action not requested.
The regional network is calling it a magnitude {mag} quake, {dist} from us, and yes, we felt the shaking at the site.
Feed: M{mag} quake, {dist} from site. Staff addendum: felt on site, lamps swayed.
Heads up, team. A magnitude {mag} quake went off {dist} from us, and the shaking made it all the way to our underground cavern. I'm logging it.
The central detector may have picked up a transient from a magnitude {mag} earthquake located {dist} away; humans in the hall also felt the ground move. Please note for calibration review.
seismo says mag {mag} {dist} out n we definitely felt it here lol
Bulletin: A magnitude {mag} earthquake occurred {dist} from the site. Felt shaking has been confirmed at the site.

• 地震信息：震级{mag}，震中距此{dist}
• 现场报告有震感
哎，刚晃了一下。台网说震级{mag}，震中离咱们{dist}。我在值班室，确实有感。
正式通报：据测定，{dist}外发生震级{mag}地震，本站观测到明显震感。
哥们，刚地动了！手机弹窗说震级{mag}，在{dist}外。我站这儿脚底下都有感觉。
[自动转发] 地震速报：震级{mag}，距本站{dist}。// 控制室这边确实晃了。
地震。震级{mag}，离这里{dist}远。我在这里感觉到摇。
夜勤中。{dist}先でM{mag}の地震、こっちも揺れた。以上。
地震です。{dist}離れたところでM{mag}。ここでも揺れを感じました。
やばい、{dist}先でM{mag}の地震！解析室でもしっかり揺れた、みんな大丈夫？
地震の規模は{mag}、震源は{dist}先。当サイトでも揺れを観測しました。
Queridos colegas, me permito avisarles que el servicio sismológico reporta un temblor de magnitud {mag} cuyo epicentro quedó a {dist}; por acá, en nuestra casa, el suelo se dejó sentir.
Operador de turno: sismo M {mag}, a {dist} de la sala. Se sintió el remezón, y el café no ayudó.
Hubo terremoto. Magnitud {mag}. A {dist} de aquí. Nosotros sentimos temblor aquí.
El oficial de guardia informa: se registró un sismo de magnitud {mag} a {dist} de esta instalación. El movimiento fue percibido en el sitio.

quake_far.t: seismo feed: mag {mag}, {dist} out. didn't feel it here. no local triggers.
Quake, magnitude {mag}, {dist} away. I didn't feel anything, and the local channels show nothing. Coffee hasn't kicked in either.
Whoa, there was a magnitude {mag} event {dist} away! Nobody here felt it, though, and none of our local readouts picked up anything.
Got a seismo ping: M {mag}, {dist} from us. Not felt on site. No local hits on the gear.
The national seismological service reports an earthquake of magnitude {mag} at a distance of {dist}. It was not felt at the site, and no local instruments registered the event.
Word from the seismic wire: a quake of magnitude {mag}, {dist} hence. We felt no tremor at the site, and the local recorders stayed silent.
feed says mag {mag}, {dist} off. no shake here. nothing on local sensors.
Just logged: magnitude {mag}, {dist} away. Not felt at site. Local DAQ quiet. Back to staring at screens.
Seismo alert - magnitude {mag}, {dist} out! I asked around: nobody felt it, and the local monitoring shows no signal.
seismic feed: {mag} mag, {dist} away. Site didn't feel it. No local triggers on any channel.
Bulletin: a magnitude {mag} earthquake occurred {dist} away. No site personnel reported shaking, and no local seismic equipment recorded any motion.
Seismic wire says magnitude {mag}, {dist} distant. No tremor did we feel at the site, and the local instruments gave no sign.
Ops note: quake mag {mag}, {dist} out. Felt on site? Negative. Local channels? Silent.
Feed just spat out magnitude {mag}, {dist} away. Nobody on site felt a thing, and our local rigs registered nothing.
台网通报：在距本站 {dist} 处发生震级 {mag} 的地震；我按流程复核过，本站没有震感，本地监测系统也没有触发任何记录。
速报：震级 {mag}，{dist} 外。这里没感觉，本地也没触发记录。
地震消息：震级 {mag}，离这里 {dist}。我们这边没有感觉，机器也没有记到。
据地震台传信，{dist} 之外有 {mag} 之地动；老朽这边并无震感，案头仪器也未留下痕迹。
【自动转发】地震通报：震级 {mag}，距离 {dist}。备注：本站无感，本地告警未触发。
困。地震速报：震级 {mag}，离我们 {dist}。这儿没晃，本地也没记到。
